**Severity:** error · **Area:** Imports / helpers / route modules (`RV3xxx`) · **Quick fix:** none

## Message

The diagnostic reads:

```text
Structural helper aliases require a named import alias
```

## How to fix

Alias in the import, not with a const: import `{ For as Each }` from "@rivetjs/runtime/dom".

## Example

```tsx avoid nocheck
import { For } from "@rivetjs/runtime/dom";
const F = For;
```

```tsx prefer
import { For as F } from "@rivetjs/runtime/dom";
```
